name: Ker sangri
description: Dried desert berries and bean pods soaked overnight and cooked in oil and spice.

tcm.note: Dried and rehydrated, cooked in oil.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and ruksha in a high degree.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; food built for a place with no water.

nutrition.highlight: built for a place with no water
